remarks: Tucked away in the heart of Topanga, this exceptional creekside retreat offers a rare blend of historic charm, natural beauty, and thoughtful modern renovation. Originally built in 1929, the two-story home is nestled into a rock formation overlooking the creek, surrounded by mature oaks, sycamores, and terraced gardens. A distinctive bridge provides access to the residence, creating a memorable arrival and setting the tone for this truly special property. Extensively remodeled since 2024, the home has been transformed while carefully preserving its original character.
